annotations.title: Truck load offer profit and walk away rate

description: Decide whether to take a load: profit after every cost including empty miles and truck days, profit per day, and the lowest rate to accept. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version and a source-page URL. No prices or omitted costs are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.
